descriptionChirho: Hifil: to move or remove a boundary marker or landmark; used of the unlawful removal of a neighbor's boundary stone (Deut 19:14, 27:17, Prov 22:28, 23:10, Hos 5:10).
Hifil: to remove or put away something (broader than boundary stones); to take something away or set it aside (Mic 6:14).
Nifal: to turn back, retreat, or withdraw intransitively; of justice or truth being driven away (Isa 59:13, Nah 2:8).
Hofal (passive of Hifil): to be driven back or pushed away; of justice being thrust aside (Isa 59:14).
